# jumpcloud_mfa_factor (Resource)

Manages whether an MFA factor type (e.g. "webauthn", "totp", "push", "sms") is enabled org-wide. Built from a captured browser request against JumpCloud's "MFA Configurations" admin page -- not documented anywhere else, including this provider's Go SDK and JumpCloud's own actively maintained CLI.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `factor_type` (String) The MFA factor type. Confirmed values from live captures: "webauthn" and "totp". The full set of valid factor type strings (e.g. "push", "sms") is not confirmed -- verify each one live before relying on it.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this factor type is enabled org-wide.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether this factor's enabled state is server-controlled and can't be changed (e.g. a factor JumpCloud always keeps available). Confirmed present on a live GET response; semantics beyond that aren't confirmed.
